## Structured fields

Schema for the specifications of a setup. These fields hold rows validated against a published schema; the form shows them as a table, the API returns them as stored. The fields of each row:

### Specifications

Specifications you want to add to your setup. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `key` | Text. |
| `value` | Object. |

The schemas are published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Setup/` (see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/)); the API view with property codes is on the [Setup API page](/api/personal_attributes/setup/#json-field-schemas).
